tools.name: audit_contract_rules
tools.description: Runs SharpFills live Polymarket/Kalshi Rule-Trap & UMA Dispute Auditor on a Polymarket URL/slug, Kalshi ticker/URL, or raw contract rule text. Returns a risk grade (A–F), numeric score, detected settlement traps, cross-venue basis comparison, and a shareable https://sharpfills.com/audit/<slug> link.

tools.name: get_live_metar_tenths
tools.description: Fetches live AviationWeather.gov ASOS METAR T-group tenths °C/°F temperatures vs. rounded whole-°C consumer weather apps, plus live Kalshi weather brackets for KNYC, KMDW, KMIA, KAUS, and KLAX.

tools.name: list_primary_catalysts
tools.description: Returns the latest primary-source catalyst events (CourtListener RECAP federal dockets, Federal Register Public Inspection filings, NWS METAR weather spikes, BLS macro prints, and Congress filings) stored in SharpFills D1.

tools.name: get_cross_venue_spreads
tools.description: Returns live Polymarket Gamma vs. Kalshi v2 market odds alongside SharpFills cross-venue spread watchlist and rule-mismatch basis-risk warnings.
